name: Kafuli
instructions: 1. Wash and blanch the spinach and fenugreek leaves, then grind them into a coarse paste.
2. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan and temper with Jakhya seeds.
3. Add finely chopped garlic, ginger, and green chilies, sautéing until fragrant.
4. Stir in the green paste and cook for a few minutes.
5. Mix gram flour with curd or water to create a slurry and add it to the greens to thicken the consistency.
6. Add turmeric and coriander powder, then simmer on low heat for 15-20 minutes until the flavors meld.
7. Serve hot with steamed rice or mandua (ragi) rotis.
description: Kafuli is a nutrient-dense, signature dish of Uttarakhand, reflecting the region's reliance on fresh greens and simple, earthy ingredients. It is considered a comfort food staple, deeply rooted in the hill culture and often prepared in an iron kadhai to enhance its traditional taste.
